title: A date with no time concatenated to text reads 1/31/2024

source.quote: CONCATENATE converts numbers, dates, and Boolean values to text with the default format
source.supports: a date joined to text takes the default format; the page says & gives the same result as CONCATENATE

source.quote: Returns the following table of a single column of String data type
source.supports: the example { 1, DATE(2017, 1, 1), TRUE, "A" } is shown returning 1, 1/1/2017, TRUE, A as strings

derivation: Concatenation converts a date to text with the default format. The table constructor example shows that conversion for a date at midnight in en-US: 1/1/2017, month/day/year without leading zeros and without a time. For 31 January 2024 that is 1/31/2024.
alternative: The published example is a table constructor, not &. If & kept the time part the result would be 1/31/2024 12:00:00 AM.
